review:
An underwater fishing game where you actually choose the grid. Reel Size Change lets you pick the reel size (and the number of paylines) before each spin, which is a neat twist on the genre.

Fish carry random cash values, and free spins do the collecting. You can buy free spins at your chosen line count, or buy Chance x3 to triple your natural bonus odds – not both. Medium-high volatility, 5,000x max and a good 96.77% RTP. Free spins land often too, about once every 70 spins.
pros: Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 70 spins on average)
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
